label: Bible Study
prompt: For I am now ready to be offered, and the time of my _____ is at hand.
verse: For I am now ready to be offered, and the time of my departure is at hand.
note: Paul senses the end is near — ready, he says, to be offered up.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many _____.
verse: Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.
note: Sparrows sold two for a farthing, and not one falls unnoticed — so you, Jesus says, are worth far more.

label: Sunday School

verse: Then I went down to the potter's house, and, behold, he wrought a work on the wheels.
note: Jeremiah's field trip to the potter's house, where the potter was hard at work on the wheels.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And he called unto him his disciples, and saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That this poor _____ hath cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury:
verse: And he called unto him his disciples, and saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That this poor widow hath cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury:
note: Two mites into the temple treasury — Jesus did the math and said she outgave every wealthy donor.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And he said, Be it far from me, O LORD, that I should do this: is not this the blood of the men that went in _____ of their lives? therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mighty men.
verse: And he said, Be it far from me, O LORD, that I should do this: is not this the blood of the men that went in jeopardy of their lives? therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mighty men.
note: Three mighty men risked their lives for water from Bethlehem's well; David poured it out to the LORD rather than drink it.
